risks.risk: Internal gear teeth may be damaged or stripped.
risks.proof: A video showing the gearbox being spun by hand to check for noise and movement.

risks.risk: The output shaft may be cracked or broken.
risks.proof: A video showing the shaft being rotated and a close-up of the shaft end.

risks.risk: The oil pump may be seized or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing the pump being tested for flow and no leaks.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the gearbox being spun by hand to check for noise and internal movement.
Close-up of the output shaft end.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
